candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) Informatik, Mathematik oder verwandte Fachrichtungen (Machine Learning)
letter.greeting: Dear DLR – Institute of Data Science team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the student position in the Machine Learning group of the DLR Institute of Data Science in Jena. Analysing complex sensor data, finding anomalies and turning experiments into robust methods is exactly the kind of research-oriented data science I want to do alongside my M.Sc. at TU Ilmenau.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence, where I built computer vision and NLP projects in PyTorch. Before my Master's I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and at TallyMarks Consulting, validating and reconciling data for company reporting.

achievements.impact: I used SQL analysis, data validation and reconciliation to keep company reporting accurate, and prepared and augmented image data for my own models
I built a PyTorch retinal OCT classifier reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set, and evaluated and tuned an EfficientNet-B0 model in my thesis team
I documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built and presented results to clients and management

letter.problems_section: In your group I would support literature research, explore the flight and sensor data for quality and completeness, build clean processing workflows in Python, and help design, test and document prototype methods for anomaly detection. Time-series and sensor data would be a new domain for me, and I am keen to learn it.
letter.closing: I study in Ilmenau, about an hour from Jena, and can start immediately with the weekly hours you offer. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
